implementerProof.how: Review 5706303462's eight findings and the one e2e fix were each driven at this head. (1) The High, the warm cache answering every version query: I reproduced the defect and the fix with a cache of my own rather than reading the diff. A scratch GOMODCACHE holding golang.org/x/text v0.3.0 alone, served as `GOPROXY=file://<it>/cache/download|https://proxy.golang.org|direct`, answers `go list -m -versions golang.org/x/text` with `golang.org/x/text v0.3.0` and nothing else — the defect. Running the image's own deletion over it, `find … \( -path '*/@v/list' -o -name '@latest' \) -delete`, the same command ends `… v0.40.0 v0.41.0 v0.42.0 v0.43.0` and `go list -m golang.org/x/text@latest` answers v0.43.0, both fresh from proxy.golang.org. The other half of the architect's bar, an exact version from go.sum served by the image with no network, holds on the real cache: I copied the 380 MiB warm cache I filled in round 2, deleted every list and @latest file from the copy (419 of them), and with a fresh GOMODCACHE and `GOPROXY=file://<that copy>|http://127.0.0.1:1` built `./cmd/legion` in packages/daemon — exit 0, a 100,685,212-byte binary, the public proxy dead throughout. worker.Dockerfile:338-339 is the deletion, and :899 is the final stage's `test -z "$(find "$modcache" \( -path '*/@v/list' -o -name '@latest' \) -print -quit)"` that fails the build if one returns. (2) One tag per digest: every one of the 12 rows' tags ends with the first eight hex characters of its own digest, all tags and all digests unique, checked by parsing the file; mirror-ci-images.sh copies `<upstream repository>@<row digest>`; its harness prints `25 passed, 0 failed` and the gate's `89 passed, 0 failed`. (3) The two-commit bump: a tree carrying a next-version bun row beside the pinned one passes the tree mode (13 rows), both bun rows moved off the pin fails with `no row copies oven/bun:1.4.4, and .bun-version locks 1.4.4 … Raising Bun is two commits`, and `ARG GO_VERSION=1.28.0` with no matching row fails with the same shape for Go. (4) PostgreSQL 18: Docker Hub answers 200 for `library/postgres@sha256:979bccfd…` anonymously, .github/ci-images.yaml holds one postgres row (`postgres-979bccfd`), stage1-skeleton.sh:154 names `ghcr.io/sjawhar/legion/ci@sha256:979bccfd…`, and no file of the tree names a postgres-16 row. The four minors: `from workflow_paths import walk` at check-ci-images.sh:941; the check-bun-version.test.sh exception is gone and the sweep now counts 28 mirror.gcr.io files where it counted 29; `ARG BUN_VERSION` is gone from packages/envoy/docker/Dockerfile and AGENTS.md's bullet names worker.Dockerfile's alone; and rule 3 now accepts either bun suffix rather than demanding both. (5) merged-root-waits: the three sibling live proofs all set `rt.InPod = true` (child_adoption:131, merged_root_waits:118, no_required_checks:141), and `go vet -tags e2e ./internal/daemon/` exits 0. I read the failing run's own evidence rather than the handoff's account: run 40966595125's `e2e-merged-root-waits` artifact holds `merged_root_waits_live_test.go:359: timed out waiting for the launch of …-architect`, and its daemon.log holds three `supervise: launch failed … command failed (exit 1): jj git clone https://github.com/acme/widgets …` lines, which is the cause the fix answers. Every other harness is green at this head: check-bun-version 120, select-e2e-proofs 94, ci-ok 40, and `check-ci-filters.sh` with `25 gates`.

observations: The offline exact-version read works for a module go.sum already holds, which is every module a role's repository builds. A module no go.sum names still needs the checksum database, and a file proxy cannot serve it: `go mod download golang.org/x/text@v0.3.0` in a scratch module with no go.sum and the public proxy dead fails, and the same command with GOPRIVATE set for that path exits 0 from the image cache alone. That is Go's checksum rule rather than anything this change does, and it is unchanged by the list deletion.

Carried from round 3 and still not acted on, by the architect's narrowing: with the package half behind the ci_images filter, a row the file names and a consumer pins but ghcr.io no longer holds goes unnoticed until that filter fires. The per-row tag — now unique per digest, which this round made stronger — and the copy's own digest read are the guard.

proof.criterion: Review round 1, High (worker.Dockerfile:439) — a role's version queries must answer from proxy.golang.org, and an exact version must still come from the image with no network
proof.surface: The Go toolchain a role runs (go1.27.1) against a file:// proxy built from a module cache, in the issue pod: first a scratch cache holding one old release, then the real 380 MiB warm cache filled as the image's go stage fills it
proof.command: GOPROXY='file://<cache>/cache/download|https://proxy.golang.org|direct' go list -m -versions golang.org/x/text, before and after `find <cache> \( -path '*/@v/list' -o -name '@latest' \) -delete`; then, over a delisted copy of the warm cache, GOMODCACHE=<fresh> GOPROXY='file://<copy>/cache/download|http://127.0.0.1:1' go build -o <tmp> ./cmd/legion in packages/daemon
proof.observed: Before the deletion the query answers `golang.org/x/text v0.3.0` alone — the reviewer's finding, reproduced. After it the same query ends `v0.40.0 v0.41.0 v0.42.0 v0.43.0` and `@latest` resolves to v0.43.0, both from proxy.golang.org. On the real cache, 419 list files deleted, the offline build exits 0 and writes a 100,685,212-byte binary with the public proxy at a dead address, so every module still came from the image. The image does both: worker.Dockerfile:339 deletes the files after `go mod download`, and :899 fails the build when the shipped cache holds one.
proof.negativeControl: With the file proxy first and the public proxy at `http://127.0.0.1:1`, `go list -m golang.org/x/text@latest` fails `dial tcp 127.0.0.1:1: connect: connection refused` rather than answering v0.3.0 from the cache: the file proxy's 404 falls through, and a dead next source says so instead of lying. Before the deletion the same command answered from the cache.

proof.criterion: Review round 1, Medium (mirror-ci-images.sh:55) — a branch that refreshes a row must not move a tag another digest's consumers pin

proof.observed: All 12 tags end with their own digest's first eight characters, every tag and every digest unique (`pgvector-2358fcba`, `nats-2.10-5498ba57`, `nats-2.15.1-alpine-2ae57dfb`, `seaweedfs-3.97-bb05d66d`, `ubuntu-534baea6`, `bun-1.4.4-1d22548f`, `bun-1.4.4-slim-1846adf2`, `golang-1.27.1-alpine-8a5910f3`, `debian-bookworm-slim-99c0b25c`, `debian-trixie-slim-f6b08b09`, `buildkit-buildx-stable-1-cec9f139`, `postgres-979bccfd`). Name this row seaweedfs-3.97-bb05d66d.` Reverted; `jj status` clean.
